name: dsh-conversation-folders
description: DSH 插件：每个会话一个专属文件夹 + 对话记录存档 + 调研后自动分类归档 + 菜单内删除对话。首次使用会话时在工作区下创建 `会话-<短ID>/` 文件夹并把会话工作目录指过去（对话产生的所有文件都落在里面），自动把对话内容写入 `对话记录.md`；每次调研（回合）结束后把新增的表格、图表、文档等文件按类别自动分文件夹存放并自动命名（`调研<N>_<原名>`）；会话「…」菜单里提供「删除对话及其内容」，删除会话时连同文件夹及全部内容彻底删除。| DSH plugin: one dedicated folder per conversation, transcript archiving, post-research auto-categorization, and a delete action in the session menu. On first use, creates `<workspace>/会话-<shortId>/`, redirects the conversation working directory into it, and writes the conversation transcript to `对话记录.md`; when each research turn ends, loose files (tables, charts, documents, ...) are moved into category subfolders with automatic names (`调研<N>_<original>`); a "Delete conversation and its contents" row in the session menu permanently removes the conversation, its folder, and everything inside.
